title: iMOD Coupler product integration
findings: Upstream DriverType currently contains metamod, ribamod and ribametamod only.
Upstream get_driver is a hard-coded product registry and exposes no external entry-point/plugin mechanism.
The actual MetaMod driver owns the coupled timestep lifecycle; F-GC50 must integrate at this product layer rather than duplicate it inside SWAP5.
F-GC49D Python runtime still consumes a positive pre-existing opaque Fortran context handle and therefore preserves Fortran/FMR state ownership.

PPA-WU01 is now canonically admitted and creates/owns the persistent Fortran/FMR application state, participant registry, mass ledgers and a per-window F-GC49D context for the restricted bottom_mode=5 groundwater profile.

PPA-WU01 does not parse iMOD Coupler product configuration and does not register an upstream product driver; those responsibilities remain product-integration work once an authorized upstream mutation route exists.
M1 is canonically closed and is not a remaining F-GC50 prerequisite.
